Module com.mathcat.mathcat
Package com.mathcat.mathcat.models

Class Item

java.lang.Object
com.mathcat.mathcat.models.Item
public final class Item extends Object
Represents an item that can be used on the cat to modify its stats or apply a cosmetic effect.

  • Constructor Details

    • Item

      public Item(String itemId, String itemName, String itemImage)
      Creates a new cosmetic Item with the given ID, name, image path, and no stat effects.
      Parameters:
      itemId - unique catalog identifier (e.g. "COSMETIC_HAT")
      itemName - the display name of the item
      itemImage - path to the item's sprite

    • Item

      public Item(String itemId, String itemName, String itemImage, ItemEffectType effectType, double effectAmount)
      Creates a new Item that applies a stat effect when used. If effectType is ItemEffectType.COSMETIC, effectAmount is forced to 0.0.
      Parameters:
      itemId - unique catalog identifier (e.g. "FOOD_TUNA")
      itemName - the display name of the item
      itemImage - path to the item's sprite
      effectType - the type of stat this item affects
      effectAmount - the magnitude of the effect
